story: Sophie is at the park with her friend Mia. Mia has a big, fluffy rabbit. The rabbit is sitting in a red basket. [emotion:QT/surprised] Oh no! The rabbit jumps out of the basket. The rabbit runs under the big green bench. Sophie gets down on her knees. [gesture:stretching] Sophie reaches under the bench and finds the rabbit. Sophie gives the rabbit back to Mia. [emotion:QT/happy] Mia is so happy. Sophie and Mia sit together on the bench. [gesture:clapping] They take turns giving the rabbit three little treats.
